title: Broaden live CLI coverage for privileged verbs
summary: The local daemon + CLI is partially covered by live tests, but several privileged verbs still lack end-to-end exercise. Add focused live CLI tests for the remaining high-risk commands so drift shows up before release evidence is generated.
expectedFailureModes: A privileged verb regresses exit codes or JSON shape without unit tests noticing.
Dispatch wiring drifts and the CLI silently no-ops or targets the wrong daemon endpoint.
Live coverage claims drift from reality and block alpha readiness unexpectedly.
nextAction: Identify 2-3 privileged CLI verbs without live coverage and add minimal live tests that prove dispatch + exit status + JSON output shape.
